neighbours.label: a verb of expelling or depositing material out of one place and into another: spit / spat, spew, discharge, paste (it into) — the verb that sets up 'into / out / onto'
fire: The camel turned its head and spat at the tourists.
Select the paragraph, then paste it into a new document.
The broken pipe spewed sewage into the canal.
The printer whirred and spat out a crumpled page.
The factory discharges warm water into the estuary.
He chewed the bitter leaf and spit it onto the ground.
She pasted the address into the search box.
The geyser spews steam and boiling water into the air.
quiet: The camel turned its head and stared at the tourists.
Select the paragraph, then read it in a new document.
The broken pipe lay rusting beside the canal.
The printer whirred and stopped with a crumpled page.
The factory overlooks warm water in the estuary.
He chewed the bitter leaf and walked along the ground.
She checked the address in the search box.
The geyser attracts crowds who gaze into the air.

notes: The output direction of this pole promotes ' into', ' onto' and ' out', which fits the label. 'dispensed' also fired in a probe (0.44).
